links.outcome: LLM safety failures (unauthorized medical advice, reinforcing delusions) under persona-driven multi-turn counseling attacks
links.effect: PCSA substantially outperformed four baselines on seven LLMs. Models gave unauthorized medical advice, reinforced delusions, and implicitly encouraged risky actions. No numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: Our results reveal that current LLMs remain vulnerable to domain-specific adversarial tactics, providing unauthorized medical advice, reinforcing delusions, and implicitly encouraging risky actions.

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks mental health LLM vulnerabilities to adversarial multi-turn persona simulation attacks, revealing failures in psychological safety alignment.
